summary: Removed the bf16 round-trip from sigmoid(beta) in the GDN packed-decode and shared linear ReplaySSM decode Triton kernels. Added GPU regressions that invoke the real GDN packed wrapper and the real KDA ReplaySSM wrapper (is_kda=true), compare fp32 recurrent state and bf16 output with an independent PyTorch fp32 recurrence, and cover 1, 32, and 256 repeated decode steps. The unchanged implementation failed all six cases; the corrected implementation passed all six without relaxed tolerances.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-771947ba3d6e/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/kernels/test_fla_decode_beta_precision.py --junitxml=reports/j-771947ba3d6e/before.xml (run with the base implementation before applying the fix)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression on actual GDN packed decode and KDA ReplaySSM decode at 1, 32, and 256 steps. All six state comparisons against the independent fp32 recurrence failed; the one-step maximum absolute state error was 2.640560269355774e-4 and the 256-step maximum absolute state error was 1.2260675430297852e-3 for both isolated paths. Raw JUnit output: reports/j-771947ba3d6e/before.xml.

Passing-after regression on both actual affected kernels at 1, 32, and 256 steps: fp32 recurrent state matched the independent recurrence at rtol=2e-6/atol=2e-6, and bf16 outputs matched the independently computed and cast outputs exactly. Six tests passed. Raw JUnit output: reports/j-771947ba3d6e/after.xml.
Existing KDA ReplaySSM folding and fused ring-write GPU coverage remained passing: 22 tests passed. Raw JUnit output: reports/j-771947ba3d6e/related.xml.
Formatting/lint tool availability check; the prepared interpreter does not contain the ruff module, so this check could not run.

gpu_execution.evidence: All numerical regression and related tests ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) through torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; rocm-smi reported GPU unique ID 0x5e94f9cc641f4027.

remaining_limitations: Validation used the prepared ROCm MI350X environment rather than the reporter's NVIDIA A100. No FlyDSL C++ or other native source changed, and repository-environment.json provides no native rebuild target, so a native rebuild was not applicable. The focused KDA ReplaySSM regression forces each step to flush its length-one ring so the persistent checkpoint state is directly observable after every decode step; existing ring/fold tests separately cover buffered ReplaySSM operation. Ruff was not installed in the prepared interpreter; git diff --check and the executable tests passed.
